zh.summary: 修复旧环境升级后，会话插件更新失败仍继续加载不兼容版本的问题。
highlights: 内置 DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 时，如果会话管理插件离线升级失败，会暂停加载已确认不兼容的 1.3.5，避免旧工作区实现阻断新建会话和输入。
暂停加载不会删除插件文件、会话或设置；其他插件的启用状态保持不变。
加强升级失败后的配置恢复：恢复写入失败时明确报错，不再静默继续启动。
knownIssues: 已有第三方插件的依赖不在离线缓存中时，默认插件自动升级仍可能失败；被暂停的旧会话管理插件需要更新至兼容版本后再启用。
upgradeNotes: Beta 1 已撤回。本版本仍为候选版，内置官方 DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2。
升级前请退出 Portable 并备份数据；第三方插件的兼容性需逐个确认。

en.summary: Prevent an incompatible session plugin from remaining active when its offline upgrade fails in an existing installation.
highlights: With DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2, a failed offline upgrade suspends the known-incompatible session manager 1.3.5 instead of allowing its old workspace implementation to block session creation and input.
Suspension preserves plugin files, sessions and settings, and leaves other plugins enabled as before.
Report profile restoration failures instead of silently continuing startup after a failed upgrade.
knownIssues: Automatic default-plugin upgrades may still fail when existing third-party dependencies are absent from the offline cache. Update a suspended session manager to a compatible version before enabling it again.
upgradeNotes: Beta 1 has been withdrawn. This remains a candidate release and bundles official DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2.
Exit Portable and back up your data before upgrading. Third-party plugin compatibility must be checked individually.
